contamination_controls.parser_inventory_use: Exact parent symbols, byte ranges, and file hashes only after the question and expected claims were authored from source.

required_claims: NewRouter is defined in chi.go and returns NewMux().
Router embeds http.Handler and Routes and declares middleware, grouping/mounting, method routing, and fallback-handler operations.
FindRoute resets transient match state, performs the lookup, appends captured keys and values to URLParams, and records the matched pattern.
Timeout wraps the request with context.WithTimeout and writes Gateway Timeout only when the derived context ends with DeadlineExceeded.

selectEncoder lowercases and comma-splits Accept-Encoding, follows configured encoder precedence, and accepts an entry when matchAcceptEncoding finds the encoder name as a substring before obtaining a pooled or constructed encoder.
isCompressible checks an exact content type and then its wildcard major type.
RealIP mutates RemoteAddr only when realIP returns a nonempty value.
realIP checks True-Client-IP, then X-Real-IP, then the leftmost X-Forwarded-For value and rejects empty or unparsable addresses.
routeHTTP derives the route path and method, invokes FindRoute, copies URL parameters into request path values, assigns request Pattern, and otherwise selects method-not-allowed or not-found.
ThrottleOpts defines retry-after, active limit, backlog limit and timeout, and status code.
ThrottleWithOpts validates limits, acquires and returns backlog and processing tokens, and distinguishes capacity, timeout, and context-cancellation failures.
RequestID preserves the configured incoming header value or generates a process-prefix plus atomic counter, then stores it in context.
GetReqID only reads the string value and returns empty for nil context, absence, or a wrong type.
The non-test Go source contains no built-in JSON body-binding middleware; AllowContentType only validates the header and forwards or rejects the request.
hard_negative_reasons: AllowContentType validates a request Content-Type whitelist and never decodes a body into a user value.

required_claims: Undefined is returned unchanged; number conversion precedes date conversion, which precedes setValueAs, then the original value is returned.
UseFormReturn collects watch/get/set/validation/reset/submission/registration/subscription operations together with formState and control.
Checkboxes yield checked, file inputs yield files, other targets yield value, and a non-object or targetless input is returned unchanged.
Missing name or signal matches; exact mode accepts equality or current-name descendants, while non-exact mode accepts either-direction prefix relationships.
useController derives the current value through useWatch and scoped form state through useFormState before constructing field state and handlers.

useWatch refreshes when its control or name changes, otherwise resynchronizes if needed, subscribes to value changes for the requested name and exactness, and unsubscribes while snapshotting on cleanup.

useFormState initializes from control state, resynchronizes if needed, subscribes through its local proxy for the requested name and exactness, updates only while enabled, and unsubscribes while snapshotting on cleanup.
Subject exposes observers, subscribe, unsubscribe, and next.
createSubject iterates current observers for next, filters one observer from the array for a subscription unsubscribe, and replaces the array with empty for global unsubscribe.

useForm initially creates an internal control unless an external formControl is supplied; when a new external formControl identity arrives it adopts that control, attaches current formState, and resets non-function defaultValues before continuing.
useForm subscribes root state in a layout effect, marks both rendered and control state ready, and unsubscribes while snapshotting on cleanup.
PathImpl emits the current key and recurses only for eligible unseen object values.
PathInternal stops when depth is exhausted and handles tuples, arrays, and object keys through PathImpl.
The TypeScript FormState type enumerates aggregate state fields.
The TSX FormState value is a render-prop component that calls useFormState and passes the result to render.
The non-test src TypeScript/TSX source contains no localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB persistence path; useForm manages in-memory state and subscriptions.
hard_negative_reasons: useForm owns in-memory React/control lifecycle but contains no browser-storage persistence implementation.

required_claims: Controller calls useController with its props and passes that returned object to props.render.
FormProvider memoizes the enumerated UseFormReturn methods and state, provides that object through HookFormContext, and separately provides its control through the nested HookFormControlContext.
Watch maps props.names to the hook's name option, forwards the remaining props, casts the result to WatchRenderValue, and passes it to render.
FormState forwards control, name, disabled, and exact to useFormState and returns render called with that result.
FieldArray passes its props to useFieldArray and sends the returned operations to render.
useFieldArray owns the field list and array mutation operations returned to the component.
FormProvider supplies a memoized UseFormReturn object through HookFormContext.
useFormContext reads and casts the same context value for nested consumers.
Form converts values to FormData and JSON, runs onSubmit, then invokes fetch for string actions or the function action directly.

For a string action, a rejected response status calls onError and returns a status error while an accepted response calls onSuccess; exceptions caught inside either the string-action or function-action branch call onError and return an empty-type error.

Within Form, only those status and branch-catch paths construct returned error objects; submit marks unsuccessful state and sets root.server only when its awaited handleSubmit result is truthy, while conversion and onSubmit lie outside the branch try blocks.
The native form receives action and submit handling, becomes noValidate after mount, and receives method and encType only when action is not a function.
FormStateProps combines the UseFormStateProps options control, disabled, name, and exact with a render callback.
FormState destructures those options, calls useFormState, and renders its result.
A render prop selects headless mode and receives submit; otherwise Form returns a native form.
For a function action, method and encType are not passed to the native form, while string actions use the normal submission attributes.
The non-test src TypeScript/TSX source contains no WebSocket or EventSource transport; Watch is a local render-prop value subscription.
hard_negative_reasons: Watch subscribes to local form-control values through useWatch; it opens no WebSocket or EventSource.
